bank.name: Companions & Caliphs
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The rightly-guided Caliphs, prominent Sahabah (companions) and the early Islamic period.

questions.prompt: Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) is known by which title?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr (RA) is called As-Siddiq (the most truthful) for confirming the Isra and Mi'raj.

questions.prompt: Who was the second Caliph of Islam?
questions.explanation: Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA) was the second Caliph (634-644 CE).

questions.prompt: Hazrat Umar (RA) is known by which title?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) is called Al-Farooq, the one who distinguishes truth from falsehood.

questions.prompt: Which Caliph introduced the Hijri (lunar) calendar?
questions.explanation: The Hijri calendar was introduced in 16 AH (638 CE) during the caliphate of Umar (RA).

questions.prompt: Who was the third Caliph of Islam?
questions.explanation: Uthman ibn Affan (RA) was the third Caliph (644-656 CE).

questions.prompt: Hazrat Uthman (RA) is known by which title?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) is called Dhun-Noorain, 'the one with two lights', as he married two daughters of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Who was the fourth Caliph of Islam?
questions.explanation: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) was the fourth Caliph (656-661 CE).

questions.prompt: The period of the rightly-guided Caliphs (Khulafa-e-Rashideen) covers which years?
questions.explanation: The era of the four rightly-guided Caliphs lasted from 632 CE to 661 CE.

questions.prompt: Which Caliph moved the capital of the Islamic state to Kufa?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) shifted the capital from Madinah to Kufa (in Iraq) during his caliphate.

questions.prompt: During whose caliphate was Jerusalem (Bait-ul-Maqdis) conquered?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem was taken in 638 CE during the caliphate of Umar (RA), who accepted its peaceful surrender.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to be given the title 'Ameer-ul-Momineen' (Leader of the Believers)?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) was the first to be called Ameer-ul-Momineen.

questions.prompt: Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed (RA) is known by which title?
questions.explanation: Khalid bin Waleed (RA) was titled Saifullah, the Sword of Allah, for his military prowess.

questions.prompt: Which companion narrated the largest number of hadiths?
questions.explanation: Abu Hurairah (RA) is the companion from whom the most hadiths (about 5,374) are narrated.

questions.prompt: Hazrat Ali (RA) is associated with which famous sword?
questions.explanation: Zulfiqar, the double-bladed sword, is famously associated with Ali (RA).

questions.prompt: Which companion, known as the 'translator of the Quran', was the cousin of the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn Abbas (RA), a cousin of the Prophet (PBUH), was renowned for Quranic knowledge and exegesis.

questions.prompt: Which Caliph was martyred while leading the Fajr prayer?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) was assassinated by Abu Lu'lu'ah while leading the Fajr prayer in Madinah in 23 AH.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) daughters was the wife of Ali (RA)?
questions.explanation: Fatimah (RA), the youngest daughter of the Prophet (PBUH), married Ali (RA).

questions.prompt: Who are the 'Khulafa-e-Rashidun'?
options: The first four rightly guided caliphs
questions.explanation: The Khulafa-e-Rashidun are Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Ali (RA).

questions.prompt: How many years did Abu Bakr (RA) serve as caliph?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr (RA) was caliph for about 2 years until his death in 634 CE.

questions.prompt: Who nominated Abu Bakr (RA) as caliph before the Saqifah meeting?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) proposed Abu Bakr (RA) for the caliphate, and the community pledged allegiance.

questions.prompt: During whose caliphate was the Quran compiled into one volume?
questions.explanation: The first compilation into a single Mushaf was done during Abu Bakr's caliphate.

questions.prompt: Who fought the Ridda (apostasy) wars during his caliphate?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr (RA) fought the apostate tribes who refused Zakat after the Prophet's (PBUH) death.

questions.prompt: Who introduced the Hijri calendar during his caliphate?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) instituted the Hijri calendar in 17 AH, beginning from the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: During whose caliphate were Basra, Kufa and Fustat founded?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) founded the garrison cities of Basra, Kufa and Fustat as administrative centers.

questions.prompt: Who was assassinated while leading the Fajr prayer in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) was fatally stabbed by Abu Lu'lu'a (Firuz) during Fajr in 644 CE.

questions.prompt: During whose caliphate was the standard Mushaf (Uthmani script) distributed?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) standardized the Quranic text and sent copies to the provinces.

questions.prompt: What title is Uthman (RA) known by?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) earned 'Dhun-Nurayn' for marrying two daughters of the Prophet (PBUH): Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum.

questions.prompt: What title is Ali (RA) known by for his bravery?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) was called Asadullah, the Lion of Allah, for his valor.

questions.prompt: The Battle of Jamal (Camel) and Siffin occurred during whose caliphate?
questions.explanation: The civil conflicts of Jamal (656) and Siffin (657) took place during Ali's (RA) caliphate.

questions.prompt: Who established the Umayyad dynasty?
questions.explanation: Muawiyah (RA) founded the Umayyad dynasty in 661 CE after the caliphate of Hasan (RA).

questions.prompt: Who is known as the 'Sword of Allah' (Saifullah)?
questions.explanation: Khalid bin Waleed (RA) was given the title Saifullah (Sword of Allah) by the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Who was the first mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) of Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal (RA), an Abyssinian companion, was chosen as the first mu'adhdhin.

questions.prompt: Who proposed the Adhan (call to prayer) after seeing a vision?
questions.explanation: Abdullah bin Zaid (RA) saw the Adhan in a dream, and the Prophet (PBUH) confirmed it.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to accept Islam from among the women?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA), the Prophet's wife, was the first person overall to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the first scribe of the revelation?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) is counted among the earliest scribes of the Quranic revelation.

questions.prompt: Who is called 'Umm-ul-Mu'minin'?
questions.explanation: All the wives of the Prophet (PBUH) are titled Ummahat-ul-Mu'minin (Mothers of the Believers).

questions.prompt: Who was the governor of Syria under Umar (RA) and later founder of the Umayyads?
questions.explanation: Muawiyah (RA) was appointed governor of Syria by Umar (RA).

questions.prompt: Who conquered Egypt during Umar's caliphate?
questions.explanation: Amr ibn al-Aas (RA) led the conquest of Egypt in 641 CE.

questions.prompt: Who commanded the Muslim army at the Battle of Qadisiyyah against Persia?
questions.explanation: Saad bin Abi Waqas (RA), a companion and maternal uncle of the Prophet (PBUH), led at Qadisiyyah.

questions.prompt: Who was called the 'Trustee of the Ummah' (Amin-ul-Ummah)?
questions.explanation: Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah (RA) was titled Amin-ul-Ummah (Trustee of the Ummah).

questions.prompt: Who was the first to accept Islam among the Persians?
questions.explanation: Salman al-Farsi (RA), who sought the truth across lands, embraced Islam in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who suggested digging the trench at the Battle of Khandaq?
questions.explanation: Salman al-Farsi (RA), familiar with Persian tactics, suggested the trench.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) freed slave and adopted son, martyred at Mu'tah?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Harithah (RA) commanded the army at Mu'tah and was martyred there.

questions.prompt: Who was known as 'Abu Turab' (father of dust), a title given by the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) affectionately called Ali (RA) 'Abu Turab'.

questions.prompt: Who was the first Muazzin (caller to prayer) of Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal was chosen as the first muazzin in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) scribe and close companion known as 'the trusted one'?
questions.explanation: Uthman was known as Al-Siddiq's companion and 'the trustworthy' (Amin).

questions.prompt: Who was given the title 'Lion of Allah'?
questions.explanation: Hamza, the Prophet's uncle, was titled 'Asadullah'.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion that memorised the Quran completely and led prayers?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Thabit was a renowned scribe and reciter.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) called which companion 'the trustee of this Ummah'?
questions.explanation: Abu Ubaidah was described as the Ummah's trustee.

questions.prompt: Who was the first governor of Madinah appointed by the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Mus'ab bin Umair was sent as the first teacher/governor to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion known for his generosity called 'the prince of martyrs'?
questions.explanation: Hamza is called the chief of martyrs.

questions.prompt: Who suggested the compilation of the Quran into one book during Abu Bakr's caliphate?
questions.explanation: Umar proposed the compilation to Abu Bakr.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) cousin and son-in-law?
questions.explanation: Ali was both cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Who was known as 'Al-Farooq'?
questions.explanation: Umar was titled Al-Farooq, the distinguisher between truth and falsehood.

questions.prompt: Who was known as 'Al-Siddiq'?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr was called Al-Siddiq for his unwavering belief.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion that migrated to Abyssinia twice and later died at Mu'tah?
questions.explanation: Ja'far led the migrants to Abyssinia and fell at Mu'tah.

questions.prompt: Who was the freed slave and adopted son of the Prophet (PBUH) martyred at Mu'tah?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Haritha fell as commander at Mu'tah.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion that served the Prophet (PBUH) for ten years in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Anas bin Malik served the Prophet (PBUH) for a decade.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to embrace Islam among children?
questions.explanation: Ali was the first child to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion known as 'the gateway of knowledge'?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said Ali is the gate of knowledge.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion that narrated the most hadith?
questions.explanation: Abu Huraira narrated the largest number of hadith.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion that suggested digging the trench at the Battle of Khandaq?
questions.explanation: Salman the Persian proposed the trench strategy.

questions.prompt: Who was the last of the ten promised Paradise (Asharah Mubashsharah) to die?
questions.explanation: Saad bin Abi Waqqas was the last of the ten to pass away.

questions.prompt: Which daughter of Abu Bakr (RA) was married to the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Aisha bint Abu Bakr (RA) was the Prophet's (PBUH) wife.

questions.prompt: Umar (RA) was assassinated by whom?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) was stabbed by the Persian slave Abu Lu'lu'ah during the Fajr prayer.

questions.prompt: Uthman (RA) was martyred during which event?
options: The siege of his house by rebels
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) was martyred when rebels besieged his house in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Where was Ali (RA) martyred?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) was struck by Ibn Muljam while praying at the mosque of Kufa.

questions.prompt: Which companion was known for his beautiful recitation and was called 'the one with the sweet voice'?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) praised Abu Musa al-Ashari (RA) for his beautiful recitation.

questions.prompt: Who was the first companion to recite the Quran aloud in Makkah?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn Masud (RA) was the first to recite the Quran publicly in Makkah.

questions.prompt: Who were the sons of Ali (RA) and Fatimah (RA)?
questions.explanation: Hasan (RA) and Hussain (RA) were the grandsons of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which two grandsons of the Prophet (PBUH) are called the 'leaders of the youth of Paradise'?
questions.explanation: A hadith calls Hasan and Hussain (RA) the leaders of the youth of Paradise.

questions.prompt: Who was the first freed slave to embrace Islam?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Harithah (RA), the Prophet's (PBUH) adopted son, was the first freed slave to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the poet of the Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Hassan bin Thabit (RA) defended the Prophet (PBUH) with his poetry.

questions.prompt: Which caliph established the army register (Diwan al-Jund)?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) organized the Diwan al-Jund to pay the army stipends.

questions.prompt: Which caliph introduced the regular minting of Islamic dirhams?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) standardized the Islamic dirham coinage.

questions.prompt: Which companion was called 'Zush-Shahadatain' (the one whose testimony counts as two)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) counted Khuzaimah bin Thabit's (RA) testimony as two testimonies.

questions.prompt: Who compiled the Quran into one volume during Abu Bakr's (RA) caliphate?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Thabit (RA) led the team that compiled the Quran under Abu Bakr (RA).

questions.prompt: Which uncle of the Prophet (PBUH) fought at the Battle of Badr?
questions.explanation: Hamza (RA), the Prophet's (PBUH) uncle, fought bravely at Badr.

questions.prompt: Which chief of the Aws accepted Islam through Mus'ab bin Umair (RA)?
questions.explanation: Sa'd bin Mu'adh (RA), the chief of Aws, embraced Islam through Mus'ab (RA).

questions.prompt: Who was appointed the first governor of Makkah after its conquest?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) appointed Attab bin Asid (RA) governor of Makkah.

questions.prompt: Who are the 'Asharah Mubashsharah'?
questions.explanation: The Asharah Mubashsharah are the ten companions given glad tidings of Paradise.

questions.prompt: Which of the following was NOT among the ten promised Paradise?
questions.explanation: Amr ibn al-Aas (RA) is not among the ten promised Paradise.

questions.prompt: Which two companions were martyred at the Battle of the Camel?
questions.explanation: Talha (RA) and Zubair (RA), both among the ten promised Paradise, fell at the Battle of the Camel.

questions.prompt: Which companion gave all his wealth in the way of Allah and kept nothing for his family?
questions.explanation: When Abu Bakr (RA) brought all his wealth, the Prophet (PBUH) asked what he left for his family.

questions.prompt: Who was the chief of the Khazraj who was a candidate for leadership at Saqifah?
questions.explanation: Sa'd bin Ubadah (RA), chief of the Khazraj, was proposed at Saqifah Bani Sa'idah.

questions.prompt: Who was the first governor of Kufa?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) appointed Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (RA) as the first governor of Kufa.

questions.prompt: Which companion embraced Islam after reading Surah Ta-Ha?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA) was moved to accept Islam after hearing Surah Ta-Ha.

questions.prompt: Uthman (RA) is called 'Dhul-Hijratayn' because he?
options: Migrated to both Abyssinia and Madinah
Made two pilgrimages with the Prophet (PBUH)
Married two daughters of the Prophet (PBUH)
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) took part in both migrations — to Abyssinia and to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the document of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) wrote the terms of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.

questions.prompt: Which title did Abu Bakr (RA) use after becoming caliph?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr (RA) styled himself Khalifat-ur-Rasul, successor of the Messenger.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) scribe who recorded the revelation and was martyred at Yamama?
options: Salim, the freed slave of Abu Hudhayfah (RA)
questions.explanation: Salim (RA), a leading Quranic reciter, was martyred at the Battle of Yamama.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion known as 'the one whom the Prophet (PBUH) loved and who loved him'?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said he loved Usama bin Zaid (RA) and that Usama loved him.

questions.prompt: Which companion was the first to be appointed as the 'Mu'adhdhin' of the Prophet's Mosque?
questions.explanation: Bilal (RA) was the first mu'adhdhin of the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Which companion was the standard-bearer of the Muslims at the Battle of Mu'tah?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Harithah (RA) carried the standard at Mu'tah until his martyrdom.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion famous for his eloquence who delivered the Prophet's (PBUH) message to the Persians?
questions.explanation: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (RA) was sent to the Persian court.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion who carried the message of Islam to the Negus of Abyssinia?
questions.explanation: Amr bin Umayyah al-Damri (RA) delivered the Prophet's (PBUH) letter to the Negus.

questions.prompt: Which companion was the first to be martyred among the Ansar at Badr?
questions.explanation: Harithah bin Suraqah (RA) was martyred at Badr and the Prophet (PBUH) said he is in Paradise.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion known as 'the guardian of the Prophet's (PBUH) secrets'?
questions.explanation: Hudhayfah (RA) was entrusted with the names of the hypocrites.

questions.prompt: Which companion was the first to give the 'Salam' greeting as a Sunnah?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn Salam (RA), the Jewish scholar who accepted Islam, was known for his knowledge.

questions.prompt: Who was the companion who was the Prophet's (PBUH) chamberlain and gatekeeper?
questions.explanation: Anas bin Malik (RA) served the Prophet (PBUH) from childhood.
